notes: Department of Logistics and Infrastructure (DIPL) civil standard drawing, CAD sheet in colour; every dimension from the sheet unless stated; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. Sheet CS3507 'Limited compression braking information sign' (2017), table type B: A 2000 square, R 250; B 25 black border with C 50 = edge + border (white edge 25); D 130 margin to the yellow panel (retroreflective yellow, black border H 30, gap K 75, REDUCE NOISE M 150 'DM' = Series D, cap top 235); G 104 to the truck, N 436 tall x P 1386 wide (P dimensioned over the truck), centred; G 104 to PLEASE LIMIT / COMPRESSION / BRAKING E 180 'DM' (Series D), F 98 between lines, D 130 at the bottom: chain D K H M H K G N G E F E F E D = 2000. Panel corner radii and word gaps not stated (panel R measured about 50 outer; REDUCE NOISE gap measured 162 at type A; the lower lines' word gap taken as the letter height). Type A for residential/urban perimeters, type B for multilane roads. The sheet's CAD text is letter-spaced wider than AS 1744 (no width check). Overlay against the type A sheet for both.
